claim.quote: COSINUS built and commissioned a dedicated low-background cryogenic facility at the LNGS underground laboratories.

name: COSINUS -- a model-independent challenge of the DAMA/LIBRA dark matter claim with cryogenic NaI detectors operated in a new low-background facility
notes: Facility and schedule paper (arXiv preprint); the planned Run 1 start has not been confirmed by any source read.

summary.plain: COSINUS describes its finished underground facility at Gran Sasso and its plan for a first run with eight crystals, intended to test DAMA/LIBRA's signal without relying on assumptions about dark matter.
summary.technical: Facility and detector status: dry dilution cryostat in a water-tank shield and muon veto in Hall B of LNGS, remoTES NaI modules; COSINUS-1pi Run 1 (eight modules, 100 kg d) planned for late 2025, Run 2 up to 1000 kg d; model-independent cross-check of DAMA/LIBRA with a few hundred kg d.

title: COSINUS -- a model-independent challenge of the DAMA/LIBRA dark matter claim with cryogenic NaI detectors operated in a new low-background facility
why_it_matters: It is the most recent description by the collaboration of the facility and the staged physics programme.
